alphabet_caption: Point to each letter until students guess: A is for Airplane!

story.short_summary: The teacher takes students on an imaginary airplane trip. They learn about airplanes and how they fly.
story.call_and_response_note: Children repeat the key phrase chorally when Aero appears.
story.full_story_speaker_notes: [TEACHER NAME] gathers the children and says, 'Today, we are going on an imaginary adventure in the sky.' They pretend to board an airplane. 'Look! It’s Aero the Airplane,' says [TEACHER NAME] as they show a paper cutout of an airplane prop. 'Aero wants to fly high in the sky. Can you all say, Fly high, Aero?' Children respond in unison, 'Fly high, Aero!' [TEACHER NAME] continues, 'Let's build our own airplanes so we can all join Aero in the sky!'
observation_questions: What color is Aero the Airplane?
How many wings does the airplane have?
What shape is the airplane's propeller?

script.text: Teacher, teacher, how does the airplane fly?

script.text: It takes off with a roar, soar soar soar!

script.text: Teacher, teacher, how does it land?

script.speaker: teacher
